_about: The launch-pair coverage audit (docs/animation/launch-pair-coverage.md): every move, shot kind, ending and set piece the next update plays, per fighter, and the pose, sequence or key set that plays it. Generated by scratch from Combat's recipes, Game Design's plans and the wave files; checked by render/anim/tools/coverage.gd. status: live (plays in a live match today), parked (posed, plays when the fighter lands or the event is wired), design (no body pose by design), later (outside this update), blocked (waits on a ruling or an asset), gap (a hole).
